blogs.title: How a Tiny 7B Model Outsmarted Giants: The Power of High-Quality Math Data
blogs.description: This post explores the surprising finding that model size isn't everything. We break down how DeepSeekMath achieved top-tier performance on competition-level math benchmarks using just 7 billion parameters—approaching the capabilities of massive models like GPT-4. The secret? A meticulous data selection pipeline that mined 120 billion math tokens from the public web (Common Crawl) rather than relying solely on academic papers or expensive proprietary datasets.

blogs.title: Beyond Code: Why Teaching AI Programming Makes It Better at Math
blogs.description: Discover the unexpected link between coding and mathematical reasoning. This article explains DeepSeek's strategy of initializing their math model with a code-trained foundation (DeepSeek-Coder). We dive into their experiments showing that exposure to code significantly boosts a model's ability to solve complex math problems, both by generating step-by-step logical arguments and by writing Python scripts to verify calculations.

blogs.title: Smarter, Lighter Reinforcement Learning: Introducing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
blogs.description: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is powerful but computationally expensive. This post introduces GRPO, a novel algorithm from DeepSeekMath that removes the heavy 'critic' model usually required for RL training. Instead of comparing every output to a separate value network, GRPO compares groups of answers generated for the same question against each other. Learn how this simple shift drastically reduces memory usage while pushing mathematical reasoning scores past previous limits.
